name: Card
description: Six composable parts. No variants — a card is a container, and its meaning comes from what you put in it.
intent: Group related content into a unit the eye reads as one thing.

props.name: as
props.hint: Optional. Declared in the component source.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

notes: A Card is a div. It carries no semantics of its own — that is correct and deliberate.

CardTitle renders <h3> by default, which is right inside an <h2> section and wrong directly under the page <h1>. Set `as` to match the real outline — screen-reader users navigate by heading, so a page of cards at the wrong level is a broken outline.
For a card grid, wrap in a ul and each card in an li so the count is announced.
A whole-card click target needs a real button or link inside — do not attach onClick to the Card div.

usage: Grouping related information with a clear boundary
Repeating items in a grid or list
Sectioning a settings or dashboard page
doNotUse: Wrapping every element on the page — nesting cards in cards destroys the hierarchy they exist to create
A single paragraph with no grouping need
As a clickable button — put the interactive element inside, or the whole card in a link
onClick on the Card div with no focusable child

agentRules: Set `as` on CardTitle to match the surrounding heading level. The h3 default is a guess about context it cannot see.
CardContent has pt-0 — using it without CardHeader leaves the top padding wrong.
Clickable cards need a real interactive element inside.
